answer: Memory-hard sequential proofs force every agent to perform sequentially bound computation that resists parallelization and ASIC advantage, making sybil creation prohibitively expensive. An attacker seeking to forge a thousand identities cannot bypass the delta of required sequential steps; each ivory-white proof of honest work must complete its voyage through the memory-bound function before the next nonce can be issued. This binds identity creation to real time and memory, not just capital.
